北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感 6℃ 略凉，出门记得添衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Beijing, feels like 6℃, remember to dress warmly when going out!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 11℃，湿度较高，小心着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Cixi, feels like 11℃ with high humidity, mind the chill.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有雨，体感 11℃，出门带伞，路滑慢行哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Rainy in Shanghai, feels like 11℃, take an umbrella and walk carefully on slippery roads.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 26℃ 比较舒适，注意防晒。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Guangzhou, feels like a pleasant 26℃, remember sun protection.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 23℃，早晚温差不大，轻装出行。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Shenzhen, feels like 23℃. Minimal temperature difference, dress lightly.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州中雨，体感 10℃，湿冷，记得带好雨具，多穿点。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Moderate rain in Hangzhou, feels like 10℃. It's damp and cold, bring rain gear and dress warmly.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 5℃ 且湿度 100%，湿冷感强，注意保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Nanjing, feels like 5℃ with 100% humidity. It's very damp and cold, stay warm.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 21℃ 舒适，湿度较低，注意补水。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Chengdu, feels like a comfortable 21℃, low humidity, stay hydrated.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 5℃，风力 3级，风寒效应明显，多穿点。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Wuhan, feels like 5℃ with a 3-level wind, significant wind chill. Dress warmly.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 9℃，注意适时增减衣物，预防感冒。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Xi'an, feels like 9℃. Adjust your clothing as needed to prevent colds.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 19℃ 宜人，适宜外出活动。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Chongqing, feels like a pleasant 19℃, suitable for outdoor activities.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 -11℃ 极寒，请全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Harbin, feels like an extremely cold -11℃. Bundle up completely and protect against frostbite.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感 -10℃ 严寒，出门多穿，防止感冒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Shenyang, feels like a severe -10℃. Dress warmly when going out to avoid colds.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 12℃ 略凉，风力 3级，注意添衣哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Kunming, feels a bit cool at 12℃ with a 3-level wind, remember to add layers.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 15℃ 舒适，湿度较高，注意防潮。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Xiamen, feels like a comfortable 15℃, high humidity, mind the dampness.
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感 2℃ 湿冷，注意保暖，小心感冒。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Qingdao, feels damp and cold at 2℃, stay warm and be careful not to catch a cold.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，体感 3℃，风力 2级，早晚温差大，别忘了加衣服。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Dalian, feels like 3℃ with a 2-level wind. Large temperature difference, don't forget extra layers.
